text: RESULTS: {'Chest_X-Ray': 'Clear to auscultation bilaterally, no infiltrates or consolidations.', 'Skin_Biopsy': 'Epidermal necrosis and detachment, consistent with severe drug reaction.'}

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome (SJS) secondary to a new medication for arthritis.

The skin biopsy confirms epidermal necrosis and detachment, which is characteristic of a severe cutaneous adverse reaction. Given your recent initiation of arthritis treatment and the acute onset of the rash, the medication is the likely culprit. We have ruled out pneumonia based on your clear chest X-ray. Please ensure you stop the suspected medication immediately and proceed to the dermatology unit for further management.
